sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I2,
to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Vertical 6.3kv Siemens-Allis motor of circulate water 
pump, 900HP, ANV & Condensate water pump, 1650HP,DP

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed EL-husany, tested by 
eng. Tarek EL-kafafy, accepted by general director eng. Nady Mosaed, approved by 
eng. Mohamed EL-Tahawy Head sector of Shoubra EL-Kheima PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha CEPC quality control director, 
and certified by eng. AfafEbrahim El Dib, CEPC inspection & quality control 's 
head sector & MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items:
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category

Wear
 your safety helmet & safety shoes.

Safety
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

After
 stopping to motor insure that circuit breaker of the motor is draw out .
Avoid contact with rotating parts .

Act
 with care in accordance with prescribed procedures , in handling and
 lifting this equipment .

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the 
running conditions while the motor in service

Check the motor vibration not to exceed
60 microns .

Check that 
there is no abnormal noise on the motor

Check the bearing temp. on the Accurex in
the control room not to exceed 87 C.

Check the motor stator temp. on the
Accurex in the control room not to exceed 150 C.
Check the motor current reading of the 3 phases in the control room
Check for any oil leak

sections.text:
After isolation the circuit
breaker of the motor

Disconnect all cables supply , 
protection , and the accessories

Uncouple the motor and remove the 
coupling flange

Remove the protection devices and 
the accessories of the bearing

Remove the rotor away from the 
stator

Clean the inside of the motor (the 
rotor and stator), ventilation ducts and the windings by dry compressed air

Measure insulation resistance with surge
arrestors disconnected, the insulation should be 100MΩ or greater after
one min.

Measure the winding DC resistance, 
must be the same for 3 phase windings

Check bearing for damage and 
change it if necessary

Clean intake and outlet air 
filters

Reassemble the motor components and check
that all bolts are well tightened and put the bolt stops .

Couple the motor with the pumps shaft and
connect all cables (supply , protection , accessories ) .

Change the upper bearing oil (Type 
EDT heavy)

Remove inlet & outlet plugs and
grease the lower motor bearing with (GED6A2C5 grease) then replace inlet plug .
Tighten the ground wire.

Run the motor, after 10 min 
replace the outlet plug of the grease.
Check the running conditions.
